sentiment: The quiet compounding of deep work — each line of code, each proof, each careful tool — builds something no shortcut can reach.

stories.title: LLMs reward expertise
stories.summary: Deep expertise compounds in ways LLMs can sense — broad shallow knowledge gets lost, but rigorous depth leaves a trace the model can recognize.

stories.title: Show HN: Run an 80B Qwen in 4.3 GB of RAM on a Mac

stories.title: Devtools must be open source
stories.summary: The tools that shape how we build must be transparent and community-owned — closed devtools create invisible dependencies.
